title: Skin Care for Bhopal Weather: A Routine for Dry Summer Heat, Monsoon Humidity and Cold Winter Nights
ex: Very hot dry summers, a humid monsoon and cool dry winters: a simple skin care routine for people living in Bhopal.
rt: Skin Care for Bhopal Weather: Seasonal Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Bhopal weather: sun and moisture for dry summer heat, light layers in the monsoon and a richer routine for cold, dry winter nights.
quick: Bhopal has a very hot, dry summer, a humid monsoon from July to September and a cool, dry winter. Keep a gentle face wash and daily broad-spectrum sunscreen all year, use lighter layers in the monsoon and a richer moisturiser and full pea-sized night cream in summer and winter.
facts: Bhopal is on the Malwa plateau in central India, far from the sea
April to June is very hot and dry
July to September is the humid monsoon
November to February is cool and dry with cold nights
